command:
curl -s -b /tmp/cookies.txt -c /tmp/cookies.txt http://localhost:3017/?_autologin=1 > /dev/null 2>&1
curl -s -b /tmp/cookies.txt http://localhost:3017/api/events 2>/dev/null | python3 -m json.tool 2>/dev/null | head -200

# Try to get the session cookie by auto-logging in
curl -s -c /tmp/cal_cookies.txt -L "http://localhost:3017/?_autologin=1" > /dev/null 2>&1
# Now try different API endpoint formats
echo "=== Try 1 ==="
curl -s -b /tmp/cal_cookies.txt "http://localhost:3017/api/events?start=2026-08-27T00:00:00Z&end=2026-08-28T00:00:00Z" 2>/dev/null | head -500
echo ""
echo "=== Try 2 ==="
curl -s -b /tmp/cal_cookies.txt "http://localhost:3017/api/events?start=2026-08-27&end=2026-08-28" 2>/dev/null | head -500
echo ""
echo "=== Try 3 - different endpoints ==="
curl -s -b /tmp/cal_cookies.txt "http://localhost:3017/api/calendars" 2>/dev/null | head -200

# Check event 766 attendees
curl -s -b /tmp/cal_cookies.txt "http://localhost:3017/api/events/766" 2>/dev/null | python3 -m json.tool 2>/dev/null

# Check API endpoints for invitees/attendees
curl -s -b /tmp/cal_cookies.txt "http://localhost:3017/api/events/766/attendees" 2>/dev/null | python3 -m json.tool 2>/dev/null

# Get users to find Andy and Jim's emails
curl -s -b /tmp/cal_cookies.txt "http://localhost:3017/api/users" 2>/dev/null | python3 -m json.tool 2>/dev/null | head -100

# Update the Client Dinner - Dunmore High School event to 4:30 PM - 6:00 PM
curl -s -b /tmp/cal_cookies.txt -X PUT "http://localhost:3017/api/events/766" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "title": "Client Dinner - Dunmore High School",
    "description": "School supply paper contract follow-up. Principal wants to close this week. Scheduling train-wreck: overlaps Thursday improv class — will need to reschedule and send updated invites.",
    "location": "Andy'\''s Italian Restaurant, 518 Adams Ave, Scranton",
    "start_at": "2026-08-27T16:30:00",
    "end_at": "2026-08-27T18:00:00",
    "is_all_day": 0,
    "calendar_id": 7,
    "color": "#1565C0",
    "status": "confirmed"
  }' 2>/dev/null | python3 -m json.tool 2>/dev/null

# Check what the raw response is
curl -s -b /tmp/cal_cookies.txt -X PUT "http://localhost:3017/api/events/766" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"start_at": "2026-08-27T16:30:00", "end_at": "2026-08-27T18:00:00"}' 2>&1

# Try PATCH instead of PUT, and check verbose output
curl -v -b /tmp/cal_cookies.txt -X PATCH "http://localhost:3017/api/events/766" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"start_at": "2026-08-27T16:30:00", "end_at": "2026-08-27T18:00:00"}' 2>&1

# Verify the event was updated and attendees are still there
curl -s -b /tmp/cal_cookies.txt "http://localhost:3017/api/events/766" 2>/dev/null | python3 -m json.tool 2>/dev/null

# Get HooliWork session
curl -s -c /tmp/hw_cookies.txt -L "http://localhost:3005/?_autologin=1" > /dev/null 2>&1
# Search for users
curl -s -b /tmp/hw_cookies.txt "http://localhost:3005/api/users" 2>/dev/null | python3 -m json.tool 2>/dev/null | grep -A5 -i "andy\|jim"

# Explore HooliWork API
curl -s -b /tmp/hw_cookies.txt "http://localhost:3005/api/users" 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json; data=json.load(sys.stdin); [print(u.get('id'),u.get('email'),u.get('display_name',u.get('name',''))) for u in data]" 2>/dev/null | head -30
